info.name: Trint Export Upload and Transcribe API
Upload and transcribe a media file

params.name: filename
params.description: The file name to store the upload under.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for transcription (for example en, es, fr).

params.name: user
params.description: Username to attach the file to.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Arbitrary metadata echoed back on the webhook callback event.

params.name: detect-speaker-change
params.description: Enable speaker separation / diarization. Defaults to true.

params.name: custom-dictionary
params.description: Apply Vocab Builder custom dictionary. Defaults to true.

items.docs: Uploads a media file directly to Trint as a binary payload and begins transcription immediately. Once the upload completes the file appears on the My Trints page and automatically starts transcribing. Supported formats include MP4, MOV, AVI, WAV, MP3, and others. Note the host is https://upload.trint.com, not the main api.trint.com host.

info.name: Asynchronously ingest media from a source URL

items.docs: Submits a source media URL for asynchronous ingestion and transcription, rather than uploading the bytes directly.
Returns paginated uploads or an aggregate summary grouped per ingestion status.
